Jukebox

Plays audio with the Web Audio API: decodeAudioData, AudioBufferSourceNode and a GainNode. The five 4-second clips were made for this repository (CC0 1.0, third_party/media), in MP3, Ogg Vorbis and Opus; this page makes the WAV itself. Open audio files of your own with the file button.
